import subprocess,json,sys,pathlib,hashlib
p=pathlib.Path('/src/package-lock.json');before=p.read_bytes();package=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/src/package.json').read_text());assert package['scripts'].get('build-bundle')=='webpack' and not any(x in package['scripts'] for x in ['prebuild-bundle','postbuild-bundle'])
for cmd in [['node','--version'],['npm','--version'],['npm','ci','--ignore-scripts','--no-audit','--no-fund','--cache','/src/.build-only-npm-cache'],['node','node_modules/webpack-cli/bin/cli.js']]:
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);print(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'exit':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr}),flush=True)
 if r.returncode:sys.exit(r.returncode)
assert p.read_bytes()==before,'Immutable source lock changed during isolated tooling install'
print(json.dumps({'lockSha256Unchanged':hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),'distributionOnlyArtifacts':{str(x):hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for x in pathlib.Path('/src/dist').glob('*') if x.is_file()}}),flush=True)
